features.name: plas_zscore
features.description: Standardized plasma glucose concentration using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth standardized projection useful for linear margin separation.

features.name: mass_zscore
features.description: Standardized BMI using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth normalized BMI severity for linear separator.

features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Standardized age using training mean and std.
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous age effect normalized for linear SVM weighting.

features.name: glucose_hyperglycemia_severity
features.description: Continuous severity above clinical hyperglycemia threshold (140 mg/dL), zero below.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a clinically grounded one-sided severity score for linear margin.

features.name: bmi_obesity_severity
features.description: Smooth severity score above BMI obesity threshold (30), zero below.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-linear obesity risk as a smooth continuous score.

features.name: insulin_glucose_ratio
features.description: Insulin to plasma glucose ratio with log dampening; proxy for insulin response.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio reflecting metabolic response, useful as a near-linear projection.

features.name: skin_to_bmi_ratio
features.description: Skin thickness normalized by BMI; body fat distribution proxy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a body-composition ratio independent of overall mass.

features.name: missing_measurement_count
features.description: Count of biologically implausible zero values across measurement columns.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures data quality signal that often correlates with measurement context.

features.name: weighted_risk_composite
features.description: Linear weighted composite of standardized glucose, BMI, age, and pedigree.
features.expected_model_benefit: Pre-built linear projection aligned with clinical risk factors; aids linear SVM.

features.name: preg_age_interaction
features.description: Pregnancies per decade of life beyond reproductive baseline.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures reproductive history density as smooth interaction term.

features.name: metabolic_stress_judgment
features.description: Holistic semantic assessment of combined metabolic stress integrating glucose elevation, BMI excess, and insulin pattern into a smooth 0-1 risk gauge.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a non-formulaic semantic severity reading complementing the linear features.

features.name: physiological_plausibility_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of how physiologically coherent the row's measurements are together (e.g., consistency between BMI, skin thickness, blood pressure, and age).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures data coherence signal that adjusts confidence margins for the linear model.
